name: Website Development
shortIntro: Custom, mobile-responsive and SEO-ready websites designed to convert visitors into paying clients. From single landing pages to comprehensive business portals and web tools.

faqs.q: How long does it take to deliver a business website?
faqs.a: Standard landing pages take 2–4 days, while full business websites usually take 5–8 days depending on content readiness.

faqs.q: Are all websites mobile-friendly and fast?
faqs.a: Yes, 100%. All our websites are optimized for high mobile speed, responsive across all screen sizes, and built SEO-ready by default.

faqs.q: Can I update the content myself later?
faqs.a: Yes, we provide user-friendly setups or management guidance so you can easily update text, images, and prices.

name: Website Support & Fixes
shortIntro: Fast resolution for website bugs, WordPress errors, SSL warnings, speed issues, and broken layouts. Same-day emergency fixes available.

faqs.q: How quickly can you fix a broken website?
faqs.a: Most urgent bugs, layout issues, and SSL errors are diagnosed and fixed within 1 to 4 hours.

faqs.q: What do you need from me to start?
faqs.a: We will need temporary admin access or hosting credentials. We strictly follow safe backup procedures before touching any live files.

faqs.q: Do you provide monthly website maintenance?
faqs.a: Yes! Our monthly maintenance plans start at ₹1,000/month and cover security, plugin updates, speed checks, and regular backups.

name: Domain, Hosting & Technical Setup
shortIntro: Professional setup for domains, DNS records, business emails, SSL certificates, Cloudflare CDN, Google Analytics, and Search Console.

faqs.q: Can you set up professional business email like info@mybusiness.com?
faqs.a: Yes, we configure business email on Google Workspace, Zoho Mail, or your cPanel, and connect it to your phone and laptop.

faqs.q: My domain is not pointing to my website. Can you fix it?
faqs.a: Yes, DNS propagation and record mapping (A, CNAME, MX, TXT) are usually resolved within 30–60 minutes.

faqs.q: Do you set up Google Search Console and indexing?
faqs.a: Yes, we submit your sitemap, verify ownership, and resolve crawl errors so your pages appear properly on Google search.

name: Android App Development
shortIntro: Lightweight, high-performance native Android apps built for your business, utilities, or Play Store publishing with monetization setup.

faqs.q: Do you help publish the app to Google Play Store?
faqs.a: Yes, we provide end-to-end Play Console setup, policy compliance check, asset preparation, and store publishing assistance.

faqs.q: Can you integrate AdMob and Play Billing?
faqs.a: Yes, we integrate Google AdMob banners, interstitials, rewarded ads, and Google Play in-app subscriptions.

faqs.q: Will the app work offline?
faqs.a: Yes, we can design apps with robust offline SQLite/Room databases or local file storage depending on your requirements.

name: Chrome Extensions
shortIntro: Custom Chrome extensions to automate workflows, scrape data, enhance web apps, or launch digital SaaS tools on the Chrome Web Store.

faqs.q: Are your extensions built using Manifest V3?
faqs.a: Yes, all our Chrome extensions strictly adhere to Google Chrome's Manifest V3 standards for maximum security and store compliance.

faqs.q: Can extensions communicate with external APIs?
faqs.a: Yes, we securely integrate third-party APIs, AI services, and custom backends into your extension.

faqs.q: Do you handle Web Store submission?
faqs.a: Yes, we assist with zip packaging, icon sets, store privacy policies, and Chrome Web Store review requirements.

name: SEO & Local SEO
shortIntro: Proven search engine optimization to rank your business at the top of Google search results in your city and target service areas.

faqs.q: What is the difference between General SEO and Local SEO?
faqs.a: Local SEO focuses on ranking in Google Maps and local 3-pack search queries (e.g. 'dentist in Noida'), driving phone calls and walk-ins.

faqs.q: How soon can I see SEO results?
faqs.a: Local SEO improvements often show within 3 to 6 weeks, while competitive organic keywords take 2 to 4 months of consistent effort.

faqs.q: Do you provide monthly SEO reports?
faqs.a: Yes, our monthly clients receive transparent keyword ranking reports, traffic graphs, and work logs.

name: Google Business Profile & Google Maps
shortIntro: Complete Google Business Profile setup, pin correction, category optimization, legitimate review systems, and monthly ranking management.

faqs.q: My business pin is in the wrong location on Google Maps. Can you fix it?
faqs.a: Yes, we calibrate coordinates and submit official location corrections to ensure customers navigate directly to your door.

faqs.q: Do you do fake reviews?
faqs.a: No, we strictly never provide or buy fake reviews. We set up legitimate review-generation QR systems that prompt real customers.

faqs.q: Can you help reinstate a suspended Google Business Profile?
faqs.a: Yes, we audit your business proof, align guidelines, and submit official reinstatement appeals to Google support.

name: Local Business Packages
shortIntro: All-in-one digital growth packages combining Google Maps, website, digital visiting cards, and ad creatives for shops, clinics, and startups.

faqs.q: What is included in the Basic Package (₹4,999)?
faqs.a: Google Business Profile creation + Maps optimization + Digital visiting card + 1 professional ad creative design.

faqs.q: What is included in the Standard Package (₹14,999)?
faqs.a: Full business website + Google Business Profile and Maps optimization + Basic SEO + Social ad creatives.

faqs.q: Do you provide custom industry packages?
faqs.a: Yes! We have specialized bundles for Clinics, Restaurants, Salons, Coaching Centers, and Retail Shops.

name: Graphic & Ad Design
shortIntro: Crisp logos, digital visiting cards, banners, festival creatives, social media packs, and YouTube thumbnails crafted for your brand.

faqs.q: What formats do you provide for logos?
faqs.a: High-resolution PNG (transparent background), JPG, vector SVG, and print-ready PDF.

faqs.q: What is a Digital Visiting Card?
faqs.a: An interactive digital card with clickable Call, WhatsApp, Map, and Website buttons that you can share easily on WhatsApp.

faqs.q: How fast do you deliver creatives?
faqs.a: Single ad creatives and thumbnails are delivered within 24–48 hours.

name: AI Content & Image Services
shortIntro: Harness cutting-edge AI for high-impact commercial images, social marketing copy, customized product visuals, and smart chatbots.

faqs.q: Can AI images be used for commercial advertisements?
faqs.a: Yes, we generate high-resolution visuals optimized with prompt engineering tailored for commercial advertising.

faqs.q: Can you build an AI chatbot for my website or WhatsApp?
faqs.a: Yes, we configure AI assistants trained on your business information, FAQs, and price list to handle customer inquiries.

faqs.q: Do you refine and edit the AI outputs manually?
faqs.a: Yes, every AI output is quality-checked, proofread, and graphically adjusted before final delivery.

name: YouTube Services
shortIntro: Complete YouTube channel setup, banner branding, high-CTR thumbnail design, SEO tags, and monthly video management for creators.

faqs.q: Do you buy or sell YouTube channels or subscribers?
faqs.a: No. We strictly abide by YouTube guidelines and do NOT buy/sell channels, views, or subscribers. We provide organic channel optimization.

faqs.q: How do your SEO tags and titles help?
faqs.a: We analyze search volume and competition to craft titles and descriptions that rank in YouTube Search and Suggested Videos.

faqs.q: Can you design custom thumbnails?
faqs.a: Yes, we design eye-catching, high-converting thumbnails from ₹500 each.

name: Instagram & Social Media
shortIntro: Professional Instagram & Facebook profile optimization, content calendar packs, viral captions, and monthly management plans.

faqs.q: What is included in the Profile Optimization?
faqs.a: Bio copywriting, custom bio link, highlight covers, category tag, and contact button setup.

faqs.q: Do you provide monthly social media posting?
faqs.a: Yes, our monthly packages range from ₹3,000 to ₹6,000/month and include graphics, captions, hashtags, and scheduling.

faqs.q: Do you ever ask for my account password?
faqs.a: No, never. We provide ready-to-post creatives or request editor access via Meta Business Suite.

name: Content Writing
shortIntro: Engaging, conversion-focused website copy, SEO blog posts, corporate profiles, and proofreading that build authority and trust.

faqs.q: Is the content 100% original and plagiarism-free?
faqs.a: Yes, all content is written to your specific guidelines, grammatically polished, and checked for originality.

faqs.q: Are the blog posts written for SEO?
faqs.a: Yes, articles include target keywords, meta descriptions, clear H2/H3 headers, and internal linking suggestions.

faqs.q: What is the typical delivery timeframe?
faqs.a: Single articles (800–1,500 words) are delivered within 24–48 hours.

name: PDF & Document Services
shortIntro: Fast document formatting, PDF conversions, OCR text extraction, Word/Excel cleanup, custom invoice templates, and QR code generation.

faqs.q: What is the PDF Toolkit bundle (₹999)?
faqs.a: It covers up to 5 document tasks (conversions, merge/split, OCR, compression, or formatting) at one discounted price.

faqs.q: Can you convert scanned or handwritten documents to Word or Excel?
faqs.a: Yes, using advanced OCR combined with manual verification for 100% accuracy.

faqs.q: Can you unlock my password-protected PDF?
faqs.a: Only if you are the legitimate owner of the document. We do not assist with unauthorized document access.

name: Remote Software & Cloud Support
shortIntro: Instant 100% remote software assistance, slow PC optimization, virus cleanup, and cloud workspace setups. Zero physical hardware repairs or on-site visits.

faqs.q: Do you repair physical hardware or replace laptop parts?
faqs.a: No. We specialize strictly in 100% digital, remote software, system tune-ups, and cloud configurations. We do not repair broken screens, motherboards, or physical parts.

faqs.q: How does remote software support work?
faqs.a: You share a secure temporary code using AnyDesk, TeamViewer, or Google Meet screen share. You watch our screen movements live, and the session ends the moment you close the app.

faqs.q: What if my software problem cannot be resolved?
faqs.a: We stand by our No-Fix, No-Fee promise on diagnostic sessions. If we can't solve your software issue, you get a full refund.

name: Account & Digital Setup Assistance
shortIntro: Safe, guided assistance for setting up Google accounts, 2-factor authentication, business profiles, and official account recovery steps.

faqs.q: What is your security rule regarding passwords and OTPs?
faqs.a: Strict Rule: We NEVER ask for, handle, or store your passwords, OTPs, or private authentication keys. We guide your screen or use official delegated access.

faqs.q: Can you recover my hacked account?
faqs.a: We guide you through official platform recovery mechanisms with identity proof. We never use unauthorized bypass tools.

faqs.q: Can you help set up 2-Step Verification?
faqs.a: Yes, we help configure Google Authenticator, SMS 2FA, and backup security keys to protect your accounts from hacking.

name: Technical Consultation
shortIntro: 60-minute 1-on-1 video consultation + written action summary. Get clear, unbiased expert advice on websites, SEO, apps, or business IT.

faqs.q: What topics can we cover during the consultation?
faqs.a: Website architecture, SEO audits, Google Maps strategy, app development feasibility, tech stack selection, or local digital marketing.

faqs.q: Do I get a summary after the call?
faqs.a: Yes, within 24 hours of the call you receive a comprehensive written Action Summary with step-by-step next actions.

faqs.q: How do we connect for the call?
faqs.a: We connect over Google Meet or Zoom at your preferred scheduled time.
